memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Gastro-oesophageal reflux: symptomatic with occasional heartburn after meals; currently on pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, antacid gel SOS, domperidone 10 mg BD before meals; plan: continue current regimen, review symptoms in 8 weeks.
Vitamin D deficiency: asymptomatic, baseline 25‑OH‑vit D 18 ng/mL (low); plan: start cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks then 1000 IU OD, check calcium and phosphate.
Asthma: intermittent wheeze, uses salbutamol SOS; on budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD and montelukast 10 mg HS; plan: maintain inhalers, ensure spacer use, review control.
Weight 68 kg, waist 82 cm (male cut‑off 90 cm).
Due: HbA1c 2025-07-10.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Patient reports increased heartburn after spicy meals, using antacid gel about three times this week. Asthma symptoms unchanged; uses salbutamol inhaler twice weekly, no night wheeze. No new gastrointestinal complaints.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Gastro-oesophageal reflux: heartburn reduced to once weekly, antacid gel use down to twice weekly; pantoprazole and domperidone well tolerated; plan: continue same doses, consider step‑down if symptom‑free for 4 weeks.
Vitamin D deficiency: 25‑OH‑vit D now 22 ng/mL (still borderline); plan: continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD, re‑check in 3 months.
Asthma: well controlled, salbutamol use <2 times/week, no exacerbations; plan: maintain budesonide-formoterol BD and montelukast HS, ensure inhaler technique.
Weight 67 kg, waist 81 cm.
Due: HbA1c 2025-10-20.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Spirometry with reversibility: FEV1 2.8 L (88% predicted), FVC 3.6 L (92% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.78; post‑bronchodilator FEV1 increase 12% and 0.3 L, indicating reversible airflow obstruction. Asthma Control Test score 22/25 (well controlled).

memories.text: HbA1c: 5.6% (ref 4.0‑5.6). Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 28 ng/mL (ref 20‑50). Serum calcium: 9.3 mg/dL (ref 8.5‑10.5). Serum phosphate: 3.6 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).
